title: Whether Jelly played other instruments; rehearsals she did not see
summary: She saw him only play piano and conduct; he kept her away from rehearsals.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Um, let's see. This is some information, I guess, from your uncle Monette had told Lomax once, about the- the Jell-Roll's father, Lamont, played slide trombone. Did you ever know the- No. The Jell-Roll playing any other instruments? No. He said he played a little bit on guitar and- I wouldn't know that, no. He never mentioned anything to you about it. Or in Chicago, you wouldn't have seen him play any other instruments? No. Drums or- No.

Or trombones or guitar? He didn't do anything. But I mean, he would practice with the band, and conduct the band, and play the piano. I've never seen him do anything else. Did he rehearse any bands at his home when you were there?
That you ever- In Chicago he did, but I wasn't there. Nothing you were there. No.
I mean, while I was there, but I wasn't at the house at the time. Yeah. He didn't want- he didn't want me around all this- Well, he probably didn't want me around all this music.
Some of them talk pretty rough, and all you, you know- Yeah, I guess so. Not that they're really rough, you know, they don't-
